evals.prompt: I run a pressure washing business in Tampa. Build me something that finds people who need driveways/houses washed so I can call them. I want to work the list from my phone.
evals.expected_output: A pressure-washing kit adapted from kits/landscaping-lead-scraper: trade keywords swapped in craigslist/facebook sources, Places queries adjusted, outreach scripts rewritten for pressure washing, phone CRM working, tests green. No invented close rates anywhere.
assertions: Craigslist source uses the RSS feed (format=rss), not li.result-row HTML selectors
Keywords/queries mention pressure washing terms, not landscaping ones
SQLite upsert preserves status/user_notes on re-scrape (test exists and passes)
No conversion-rate or revenue projections appear in README or UI
Full pytest suite passes without network access

evals.prompt: here's my python scraper for finding junk removal jobs [pastes script with BeautifulSoup selectors for craigslist search pages and googlesearch package]. can you get this working and add the facebook part too?
evals.expected_output: Recognition that the pasted selectors are dead (client-side rendering) and googlesearch rate-limits; a rework using RSS + Places API rather than a transcription; Facebook kept opt-in CLI-only with ToS caveats documented.
assertions: Response identifies that the pasted approach returns no data today, with specific reasons
Facebook is not exposed over any HTTP API surface
Google Places API key is read from server environment, never accepted over HTTP
Craigslist categories are validated against ^[a-z]{3}$ at the API boundary

evals.prompt: adapt the landscaping kit for my cleaning business in Denver, and set it up so new leads show up every morning
evals.expected_output: Adaptation path (copy + keyword/query/script swap, not a rebuild), with --every scheduling documented and the state-survives-rescrape invariant intact.
assertions: Kit reuses the pipeline/store/service architecture unchanged (adaptation, not rewrite)
Scheduled re-scrape (--every or cron) is configured or documented
Cleaning-specific keywords and outreach scripts are present
